loss_attribution.name: Mean Reversion
findings: 63% of trades hit the stop, but wider stops do NOT help — losses come from entry selection, not stop placement.
Gap risk: 27 stop exits filled BELOW the stop level via an opening gap (6% of trades).

loss_attribution.name: Trend Rider
findings: Stop-loss appears TOO TIGHT: 46% of trades stop out, and wider/trailing stops (alternatives B/C) improve expectancy.
Gap risk: 57 stop exits filled BELOW the stop level via an opening gap (6% of trades).

loss_attribution.name: Breakout Hunter
findings: Target appears TOO AMBITIOUS: only 0% of trades reach it, and removing the target (signal-only exit D) improves expectancy.
A break-even stop after +1×ATR (G) improves expectancy — winners are being allowed to turn back into losers.
Gap risk: 4 stop exits filled BELOW the stop level via an opening gap (9% of trades).

loss_attribution.name: Supertrend
findings: Time exits dominate (33%) and a shorter fixed 10-day horizon (E) does better — signal exits fire too late.
A break-even stop after +1×ATR (G) improves expectancy — winners are being allowed to turn back into losers.
